name: kol-emet-client
_comment_test_pins: jsdom ^26 and @vue/test-utils ~2.4 are held back on purpose: jsdom 27+ needs Node ^20.19 || ^22.12, and test-utils 2.5 pulls js-beautify 2 -> nopt -> abbrev 5, which needs ^22.22.2 (the tilde is what keeps it on 2.4). Yarn 1 aborts the whole install, devDependencies included, when any package's engines reject the running Node, and the Netlify build's Node version is set in its dashboard, not in this repo, so a newer line could break the client deploy without a test ever running. vitest stays on 3.x because adding 4.x here died inside yarn 1 itself (Invariant Violation: could not find a copy of vite to link); its engines are not the obstacle. Revisit once the Node version is pinned in the repo.
